title: Old runtime versus new runtime same-question listening check
description: One same-question A/B for hearing old plain guarded runtime text against newer shaped runtime delivery on a longer sales answer.

live_requires: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID_EN or ignored local voice config

cases.title: Same customer question with a longer trust and send-info answer
cases.question: Can you send me something first? I do not know your company, I do not want a sales pitch, and I need to understand what would actually happen next before I involve my boss.
cases.candidate_response: Good question. I am not asking you to decide on this call. The practical version is this: I can send a short summary that explains why we called, what the workflow review would check, and what a specialist would confirm before anything moves forward. If it is not relevant after that, you can ignore it or say no.
review_focus: Does the old runtime sound too flat or written?
Does the new runtime sound more natural without adding pressure?
Are transitions, pacing, and contractions better in the new runtime?
Does the answer still feel like a sales call rather than a scripted monologue?
